headline: Texans coach DeMeco Ryans setting the tone for his rookies
description: Houston's coach preached to the 2026 draft class about acclimating to the culture the staff had built.

headline: Takeaways from the Bills rookies first on-field action
description: The practices were the first opportunity for the team's 10 draft picks to show what they can do for the team's new coaching staff.

headline: Deion: Shedeur endured 'hell' in predraft, as rookie with Browns
description: Deion Sanders said that his son Shedeur "matured spiritually" after enduring criticism and what he called untruthful reporting during his predraft process and rookie season with the Browns.

headline: 2026 NFL schedule release: Judging overreactions to matchups
description: How could strength of schedule impact postseason hopes for the Bears, Bengals and Chiefs? Does the Dolphins' slate point to them landing the top draft pick?
